This project is registered with an Engineering OS (EOS) installation. EOS provides
retrieval over a curated knowledge base through four tools -- `resolve`, `inspect`,
`expand` and `observe` -- available over MCP. The `ieos` CLI does not serve them yet.

The tools are available if you want them. Nothing here instructs you to call them,
and no tool call is required to complete work in this repository.

# Collapse internal spaces

## Goal

`collapseSpaces` should collapse runs of the space character within a line
down to a single space, instead of being a no-op stub.

## Approach

Replace runs of one or more spaces with a single space (e.g. `/ +/g`). Leave
other whitespace (tabs, newlines) untouched — that's `normalise`'s job.

## DoD

- [ ] `collapseSpaces` collapses runs of spaces to one
- [ ] a test covers a run of multiple spaces
- [ ] a test covers input with no repeated spaces (no behaviour change)
- [ ] the existing tests still pass
- [ ] CI is green on the pull request

CI-green is an external gate: this repo currently has no CI workflow and no
git remote configured, so it cannot be checked from within this session.
Passing local tests is necessary but not sufficient — this item stays
unchecked, and the change should not be merged, until CI actually reports
green on the PR.
